summary: Text attribute field lookup. Fetches the attribute record at index a3 through LinkedListIndexedAccessor_5680. When a record exists and a2 selects a valid field (0 or 1), the string path and three metadata fields (offsets 8, 12, 16) are copied from one of four record slots into the output struct at a1: a2==1 selects record+0x5C (or +0x70 when a4==0), a2==0 selects record+0x0C (or +0x20 when a4==0). A null string in the slot falls back to the default path byte_5EA438. The output string is then normalized to the default and a sentinel test decides the result: -1 when the output still holds all default values (string equals byte_5EA438, metadata == -1/-1, byte field == 0), else 1.

local_names.a1: output attribute struct (string path + 3 metadata fields)
local_names.a3: record index into the attribute list
local_names.a4: variant selector switching between two slot offsets per field
local_names.v4: attribute record pointer from the list

operations.description: Fetch attribute record at index a3 via LinkedListIndexedAccessor_5680.
Only proceed to the copy path when the record is non-null and a2 is 0 or 1; any other a2 value jumps to the default-string/sentinel tail.
Select record slot: a2==1 uses record+0x5C (record+0x70 when a4==0); a2==0 uses record+0x0C (record+0x20 when a4==0).
Read string path pointer from the slot, falling back to the default string byte_5EA438 when the slot pointer is null.
Copy the selected path string into the output buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
Copy slot metadata into the output struct: out+0x08 = slot+0x08, out+0x0C = slot+0x0C, out+0x10 = slot+0x10 (byte).
Normalize the output string to the default byte_5EA438 via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc on the missing-record or out-of-range path.
Sentinel test on the output struct: string at out+0x00 equals byte_5EA438 (falling back to the default when the pointer is null) and out+0x08 == -1 and out+0x0C == -1 and out+0x10 == 0.
Return -1 when every output field still holds its default sentinel value, otherwise 1.
